scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful veiled woman in a rust robe and blue mantle appeals with an outstretched hand to a gray-bearded man in cream and ochre clothing outside a stone home, with olive trees and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard meeting centers the widow's urgent appeal to Elisha. Clothing, faces and setting are artistic conventions. Her dead husband, the creditor and her two sons are reported in her words and remain outside the picture. The ordinary household vessel does not depict the later oil miracle; this verse leaves the threat of debt slavery unresolved.
